summary: First-party Director Generator package for pinned Stage capture and local humanoid GLB animation retargeting.
context_hints: Humanoid retarget resolves exactly one frozen target and motion model reference through context.reference; it never uses asset handles or provider identity as media bytes.

Retargeting reads and writes GLBs with @gltf-transform/core so the target document's mesh, skin, material, and texture resources remain in the output; Three.js is used only for the Director core rig math.
The plugin returns declarative media bytes and relies on the Action SDK to upload the animated-model asset.
The exported plugin is an inert PluginModule; stdio starts only when dist/stdio.mjs is executed directly.

subdirectories.generators: Native clash.generator/v1 definitions for Director operations.
subdirectories.src: Transport-neutral action implementations and direct-execution stdio entrypoint.
subdirectories.dist: Generated standalone compatibility artifact; never hand-edit.

key_files.manifest.json: Versioned Director package contributions for stage capture and humanoid retargeting.
key_files.generators/humanoid-retarget.json: Retarget action model input, parameter, and animated model output contract.
key_files.src/humanoid-retarget.ts: Frozen GLB resolution, rig inspection, Three hierarchy construction, retargeting, and GLB animation append.
key_files.src/stdio.ts: Inert PluginModule with direct-execution stdio compatibility entrypoint.
key_files.examples/: Single-file studio lighting and kinetic prop TSX components for Generator-local registration; each source is a text.plain Document revision.
